description: Word Export V2 - Multi-Template DOCX Generation. Extract shared helpers from the monolithic Professional DOCX route, refactor into a template-dispatch architecture, and build DOCX generators for all 5 templates (Professional, Modern, Classic, Minimal, Creative).

userStories.title: Extract shared DOCX helpers into docx-helpers.ts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all reusable utility functions and constants extracted from route.ts into a dedicated shared module so that all template generators can reuse them.
acceptanceCriteria: New file created: src/app/api/resumes/[id]/download-docx/docx-helpers.ts

The following functions are exported from docx-helpers.ts: pxToHalfPoints, pxToTwips, hslToHex, oklchToHex, extractPrimaryFont, stripHtml, isHtmlList, parseHtmlListToParagraphs, parseHtmlToDocxRuns, extractAlignment, formatDateRange, renderInlineBullets
The following constants/types are exported: COLORS, DocxTextRunOptions interface
route.ts imports all helpers from docx-helpers.ts instead of defining them locally
route.ts continues to produce identical DOCX output (zero behavioral change)
No other files outside the download-docx directory are modified
Typecheck passes (pnpm lint)
Build passes (pnpm build)

userStories.title: Refactor route to template dispatcher + extract Professional generator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need route.ts refactored into a slim dispatcher that detects the template and delegates to the correct generator. The Professional template generation logic moves into its own module.
acceptanceCriteria: New file created: src/app/api/resumes/[id]/download-docx/professional-generator.ts
professional-generator.ts exports a function generateProfessionalDocx that accepts resume data, styling params, translations, and returns a Document object
route.ts is now a slim dispatcher: auth, data fetch, param parsing, template detection, generator dispatch, Packer.toBuffer, response
Template detection reads 'template' query param, falls back to resume.template from DB, falls back to 'professional'
When template is 'professional', dispatcher calls generateProfessionalDocx
For other templates, dispatcher returns a 501 'Template not yet supported' response (temporary, until generators are built)
Professional DOCX output is identical to before refactor (zero behavioral change)
No other files outside the download-docx directory are modified
Typecheck passes (pnpm lint)
Build passes (pnpm build)

userStories.title: Modern template DOCX generator

acceptanceCriteria: New file created: src/app/api/resumes/[id]/download-docx/modern-generator.ts
Exports generateModernDocx function that returns a Document object
Layout: 2-column table with dark sidebar (~35%) and white main (~65%)
Sidebar contains: Contact info (phone, email, website, linkedin, github, location), Education, Skills (category + items as text), Languages, Certifications/Training
Sidebar section headers use accent-colored shading with white uppercase text
Main content contains: Name (large bold), Job title with accent highlight, Summary, Experience (position, dates, company, location, achievements/description)
Accent color derived from sidebarColor using same HSL logic as modern-template.tsx
Uses shared helpers from docx-helpers.ts for HTML parsing, date formatting, unit conversion
route.ts dispatcher updated to call generateModernDocx when template is 'modern'
Generated DOCX opens correctly in Word/LibreOffice
No React template files are modified
Typecheck passes (pnpm lint)
Build passes (pnpm build)
